title: Hagia Sophia: One Building, Four Lives
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Mediterranean Travels
description: Hover over and click four views of the interior of Hagia Sophia, as a cathedral, a mosque, a museum, and a mosque again, and a cross-section of what never changed, then test yourself in Quiz mode.

learningObjectives: The learner will name the four lives of Hagia Sophia (cathedral, mosque, museum, mosque again), state for each one what was added, covered, or uncovered, and say which parts of the structure stayed through all four.
prerequisites: Layers of a city, spolia, and restoration, from [Chapter 4](../../chapters/04-byzantine-constantinople/index.md).

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Side-by-side comparison followed by retrieval practice
keyQuestions: What was added, covered, or uncovered?
What stayed through all four lives?
commonMisconceptions: Hagia Sophia has always been a mosque.
The museum years removed the Ottoman additions entirely.
assessmentOpportunities: Quiz mode: click the zone that matches each idea

controls.name: Explore
controls.description: Default mode: hover a zone for a tooltip, click it for the infobox.

controls.name: Quiz Mode
controls.description: Hides the name pills and asks 10 questions answered by clicking a zone.
